Subject: Integration Roadtrip: joint demo series + booth logistics

Hi Jamal + Sara,

Following up on last week's call — excited to get the \"Integration Roadtrip\" on the calendar. High level: a 6-stop demo series across west coast hubs (SF, LA, SEA) over Sept–Oct, co-branded sessions (30–40 min live demo + 15 min customer Q&A) and a shared booth at the SF event where we’d run tandem micro-demos every hour.

Key asks to align on this week so we can pull contracts and ops: 
- Confirm available dates for a 2-day SF presence (preferred Sept 21–22)
- Booth footprint and power needs (we can support 10x10 or 10x20)
- Primary speaker for joint demos + one slide deck and 1-page speaker bio by Aug 12
- Any required partner legal/NDAs for on-site demos (IT/security checklist)

I've attached a draft playbook with proposed agenda, booth plan, and a starter ROI one-pager — feel free to mark edits. From Redwood side I propose: Marissa lead content + slide deck, Ben run exhibitor logistics, I’ll own overall program and deal intro messaging.

If this looks good, can we lock dates today and I’ll start the venue and travel ops conversations with EventOps?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Alliances (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Markus — thanks for the clear write-up. DiaTech is in for the roadtrip and SF dates Sept 21–22 work for our team. Quick notes from our side: 

- Booth size: we can commit to a 10x20 if Redwood covers the shared furniture/AV. We need two 220V outlets and one ethernet drop (we can fall back to mobile hotspot but prefer wired).
- Speaker: I’ll present the technical integration (15–20 mins) and Sara from AvaCloud can do the customer success vignette (10 mins). I’ll send a 150-word bio and headshot by Aug 10.
- Legal: our legal team needs a short MOU for co-marketing + a checklist for any customer data used in demos. We don't need a heavy NDA for the demo environment but want to confirm no PII will be surfaced.

I’ve looped EventOps to confirm booth logistics and power. Attaching a quick photo of our prior booth setup that might inform the floorplan.

—Jamal Rahman
Head of Integrations, DiaTech Solutions

Great — glad dates line up. A couple of specifics from content/ops: 

1) Demo run-of-show (30 min total): 5 min intros -> 15 min integration walkthrough (live) -> 5 min customer vignette -> 5 min Q&A. We want the live walkthrough to hit: quick setup (under 2 min), end-to-end request flow, and one troubleshooting tip.
2) Collateral: please share a short technical checklist and any screenshots we can drop into the deck by Aug 12. We’ll produce a joint one-pager and a co-branded follow-up email template.
3) Booth staffing: recommend 3 people on-site per half-day shift to rotate demos and handle lead capture. Ben — can you confirm Redwood travel budget for two DiaTech guests and shipping costs for the extra booth panel?

Also: Jamal — can you confirm whether any demo credentials require a pre-approved IP allowlist? If so, send the IP ranges/security contact and we’ll route to infra.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Alliances Manager, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: jamal@diatech.io, sara@avacloud.com, ops@eventops.co

Marissa — quick update on ops and budget: 

- Redwood can cover one 10x20 booth split and provide furniture and AV (projector + mic). Estimated booth cost (shared) = $8,400; travel + lodging allowance for two DiaTech guests (2 nights * 2 pax) estimated at $2,600; shipping for extra panel and collateral $420.
- I'll start the purchase order process and loop finance; need a final headcount and confirmation on billing (Redwood covers shared costs, DiaTech covers any extra branding materials).
- Regarding network: EventOps supports wired ethernet drops, but they require IP allowlist 48 hours prior. Jamal — please send the IPs if you want the wired connection. Otherwise we’ll provision a secure hotspot for demo traffic.

I’ll attach the formal exhibitor order form once EventOps sends it.

—Ben Carter
